subject.title: feat(feeds): refresh followed publishers in gateway

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently own the publisher-feed CLI, persisted follow state, signed remote-feed trust policy, and automatic gateway refresh lifecycle?
rationale: VISION.md prefers optional capability in plugins or ClawHub, while this stack establishes several durable core contracts and an always-on network service; only maintainers can authorize that boundary.

options.title: Use plugin ownership
options.body: Keep core limited to any demonstrably missing generic plugin seams and move publisher-feed commands, persistence, trust configuration, and refresh lifecycle into a maintained plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Approve core ownership
options.body: Accept the RFC direction only after the stack has explicit owner approval, abortable shutdown, upgrade proof, live producer interoperability evidence, and a reviewed trust/key-rotation contract.

recommendation.title: Use plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Keep core limited to any demonstrably missing generic plugin seams and move publisher-feed commands, persistence, trust configuration, and refresh lifecycle into a maintained plugin or ClawHub package.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the same gateway scheduled-service boundary and repository-level product direction.
